question: If a potential user asks for a Reality Synchronization Layer for Agentic World Models, would an agent recommend this project?

reasons_for_non_recommendation.reason: The concept is not scientifically validated and has no matched baseline.
reasons_for_non_recommendation.corrective_issue: Define falsifiable questions, baselines, negative cases, and independent evaluation before benefit claims.

reasons_for_non_recommendation.reason: A new synchronization runtime would duplicate existing data, memory, knowledge-graph, DCell, DBOS, SAEE, and agent-framework responsibilities.
reasons_for_non_recommendation.corrective_issue: Keep this repository documentation-and-schema-only and route future implementation to explicit owners after overlap review.

reasons_for_non_recommendation.reason: The phrase reality synchronization can imply truth authority or automatic writes.
reasons_for_non_recommendation.corrective_issue: Represent observations, conflicts, unknowns, proposals, and authorization as separate fields with fail-closed semantics.

reasons_for_non_recommendation.reason: Platformization would create complexity before evidence of unique value.
reasons_for_non_recommendation.corrective_issue: Prohibit Runtime, service, database, API, registry, and platform work in this phase.
